notes.title: Twisted 2.1 is here!
notes.content:
Hi Everybody!

Changes:
- the character movement is more responsive, some animations are faster
- gravity scale increase by 25%

Fixes:
- fixed a game breaking bug when sometimes the player disappeared from the screen
- camera is no longer shaking when rolling
- other small fixes

Extra:
- type the word: "jet"  for unlimited jetpack useage

notes.title: Twisted 2.0 Update is Live!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

The 2.0 update is live!  I've worked a lot on this update,  I hope You will like it. I think this update makes the game much more fun to play. If you've already finished it, start a new game with the jetpack! :)
(note: because of the many new systems, if You find some bugs, please let me know )

Have a nice day!


Twisted 2.0 Update Patch notes:

New physics
- new physics (previously the game used 2D physics, now it uses 3D physics)
- new feet IK system (the feet now conform to ground)
- gravity reduced from 2G to 1.5G

Gameplay changes
- the time slowing and the fly ability are not connected any more
- to fly: jump and press & press hold the jump button
- new jump mechanic: tap the jump button to jump, press & hold jump button to jump higher

Other changes
- your energy bar now flashing when you can't use it
- explosion effects reduced
- new tutorial texts (level 1)
- rolling speed reduced by 25%
- new idle animation
- new jetpack sound
- lot of small bug fixes

notes.title: Update 1.5 is live! (video)
notes.content:
Twisted 1.5 Update

Patch notes:

- you can no longer double jump, you can FLY (video)
- new aiming system
- new jumping system
- new main menu
- added recoil effect to the gun
- improved gunfire effect
- you can no longer run on stairs
- you can no longer kick
- your gun no longer rotates when you aim to close to the player
- improved grenade throwing mechanics
- new idle aiming pose
- fixed some bugs with the enemy aiming
- new tutorial texts for level 1
- small changes in level 1, 2, and 3 layout

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BXRdgHkLxuA
